items.name: Alexandria Open 2025

venue.name: Alexandria Sea Scouts Club/نادي الكشافة البحرية
venue.address: 6V3P+X44 Egyptian Sea Scout، بجوار ابو العباس الجمرك، طريق ٢٦, Alexandria Governorate
venue.details: Conference room close to the entrance, upstairs in the building on the left

items.information: Welcome to the first official WCA Competition in Alexandria, Egypt! This competition will run over 2 days, with many side events on Friday and more popular events on Saturday. You do not have to attend both days, only the day with the events you want to compete in. Please go through the **Events, Schedule, First-time competitors, and Volunteers** tabs carefully to ensure you know what to expect. Special thanks to **QY Toys** for sponsoring this competition - see the **Sponsorship** tab for more information! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTE5MDUxLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7da97586da601de4e36c4a7e90ebd6df7257f93a/QY%20Toys.jpg) أهلاً بكم في أول مسابقة رسمية لمكعب الروبيك في الإسكندرية! ستُقام هذه المسابقة على مدار يومين، مع العديد من الفعاليات الجانبية يوم الجمعة وفعاليات أكثر شعبية يوم السبت. ليس عليكم حضور كلا اليومين، فقط يوم الفعاليات التي ترغبون المشاركة فيها. يرجى مراجعة أقسام **الفعاليات، والجدول الزمني، والمتسابقين الجدد، والمتطوعين** بعناية للتأكد من معرفة كل المعلومات الهامة. شكر خاص لشركة **تشيي تويز** على رعاية هذه المسابقة - انظر إلى قسم "الرعاة" لمزيد من المعلومات!

items.name: Berkeley October Weekday 2025

venue.name: Hearst Field Annex B5
venue.details: This venue is not in the same MLK Student Union building.

items.information: ## IMPORTANT: This competition is happening on a weekday, not a weekend * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.

items.name: Blindowy Piątkowy Wieczór w Gdańsku 2025
items.information: Witajcie na blindowych piątkowych wieczorowych zawodach w Gdańskim schronisku! Zapraszamy wszystkich zawodników na cichy pojedynek w konkurencji 3x3 bez patrzenia. Następnego dnia, w gdańskiej dzielnicy Zaspa, odbędzie się [Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu V 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GdanskaLigaSpeedcubinguV2025), na którą również serdecznie zapraszamy. --- Welcome to the blind friday evening competition in the Gdańsk's Youth Hostel! We invite all competitors to a quiet competition in the 3x3 blindfolded event. The following day, in the Gdańsk district of Zaspa, the [Gdańsk Speedcubing League V 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GdanskaLigaSpeedcubinguV2025) will take place – you're warmly invited to join us there as well.

items.name: Glasgow Favourites Evening IV 2025

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

items.information: ## Please read the [Favourites Competition Format tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowFavEveningIV2025#63567-favourites-competition-format) before registering. You are only able to register for a few of the events available at this competition. ##### Please be aware that this is an evening competition and does not begin until 5:35pm ### In a change to previous editions, this competition will run in 3 groups instead of 2. ### You will compete in one group, run, judge, or scramble in another group, and have time for a break in a third. ### You MUST be present for the group you are helping out in otherwise you will not be allowed to compete. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. items.name: Rocky Mountain Championship 2025
items.information: We are excited to present our 2025 Rocky Mountain Championship in Tucson, Arizona! This is the third rendition of the Rocky Mountain regional championship. Register to compete for the chance to be a Rocky Mountain champion and to experience the biggest cubing event in the Rockies!
